effects.text: One soft tactile menu confirmation, a small wooden key click with a delicate muted glass ping. Elegant modern fantasy RPG interface, restrained, clean transient, no retro beep.
One single soft boot footstep on short damp grass and soil. Close dry natural foley, gentle weight, no sequence, no voice.
One single soft leather boot footstep on polished stone in a palace, tiny room reflection, low volume natural foley, no sequence.
One hand hoe striking soft earth, short earthy thud and granular dirt scatter, detailed close natural foley for a farming RPG.
One small scatter of seeds onto loose soil, delicate papery grains and a gentle tap, detailed quiet close foley.
One short pour from a metal watering can onto soil, fine sparkling droplets and a gentle liquid splash, intimate realistic farming foley.
One metal pickaxe strike against a small rock, crisp stone crack, small gravel fragments falling, controlled natural foley, no explosion.
One small dry branch breaking with a crisp woody snap and soft leaf rustle, close natural foley, no music.
One refined fantasy RPG item discovery sound: soft paper pickup, delicate ascending celesta and glass sparkle with warm rounded tail. No chiptune, no melody from any existing game.
One gentle restorative fantasy game sound, flowing liquid shimmer and warm harp harmonics rising then resolving, elegant soft spacious tail, no voice, no chiptune.
One stylized fantasy RPG impact, quick air swish into a rounded leather and wooden thump, crisp controlled low end, tiny sparkling accent, no gore, no explosion.
One professional compact camera mechanical shutter click, crisp double curtain tick and subtle handling, close detailed foley, no voice.
One refined fantasy RPG magic action, short airy rising whoosh into shimmering glass and resonant bell impact, elegant detailed stereo, no music bed, no retro tones.
One tense stealth game detection cue, sharp brushed metallic shimmer and low restrained orchestral sting, clear attack then quick decay, no siren, no voice.
One quick soft cloak swish and leather fabric movement into cover, delicate stealth foley, intimate and dry, no voice.
One small ornate palace latch opening, subtle brass click and short wooden door creak, high detail close foley, no long ambience.
One concise original fantasy RPG success cue, warm harp glissando and three resolving celesta notes over a soft orchestral shimmer, polished restrained, no chiptune, no voice, no existing melody.
One restrained fantasy RPG failed action cue, soft low bowed metal descent and wooden tap, quick resolved tail, no harsh buzzer, no voice, no retro beep.

common_suffix: Isolated single game sound effect, begins immediately, clean ending, no background noise or speech.
postprocess: Lead-in silence removal at -48dB; loudness -19 LUFS, true peak -2dB; 44.1kHz stereo MP3 128kbps; final 40ms fade on footsteps/menu.
